policy: Maker-owned sites only (spec 003 D2). Every fetch goes through data/synth-catalog/catalog_scrape.py: robots.txt, the deny list, per-host delay, cache, then context.dev and Firecrawl under one paid cap.

status_meaning.verified_free: free fetch returned 200 and the page names the brand
status_meaning.candidate: free fetch was blocked or inconclusive; the crawl must see the brand on the page before using it
status_meaning.robots_disallowed: the maker's robots.txt disallows our crawler; never fetched
status_meaning.rejected: the domain no longer belongs to the maker
